title: チーム総合力アップ・優しい差し入れ

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hello there, Trainer. Your team has been working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It's nothing special, but please accept this small gift from me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The team is delighted by the thoughtful gift, and our bonds grow deeper!
